snippet.title: STARHOME - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Take command of the fleet of starships that is the home to the remnants of your civilization. Manage the limited space of each spacecraft and find the balance between living space, production, defenses, and weapons. Explore the galaxy as you seek refuge and safety from an overwhelming threat. 

Let us know what you think about the game. If you enjoyed Homeworld, Battlestar Galactica, or the idea of the Quarian Fleet, then this might be the game for you
